scope: Final bounded posthoc estimator-sensitivity check for V2E2-0235 using only already measured and saved native pixels. Exactly two backgrounds; no additional pixel footprint, geometry fit, selection, origin assignment or classification change.

background_contract.negative_side: median of exactly three native pixels with -12<=d<=-9
background_contract.positive_side: median of exactly three native pixels with 9<=d<=12
background_contract.both_side_medians: Both original three-pixel side medians are computed from the full geometric outer masks as context regardless of selected estimator. Empty masks are rejected.
background_contract.noise_context: 1.4826*MAD of chosen three side pixels, descriptive only; no error model or fit weighting.

training.method: Recompute signed background-subtracted profiles on true d grid -8..8 by same linear interpolation, normalize each by positive signed sum, coordinatewise median, then normalize signed median sum. Retain negative samples; no clipping or replacement. All232 dispositions retained.

windows.blocked_policy: Keep all18 window slots and all198 row slots; blocked rows have explicit reasons. Preserve maps/raw and NaN model/residual arrays for blocked windows. No replacement or tuning.

fit_contract.amplitude: One signed unweighted OLS amplitude; fixed background and template, no intercept, no centroid/width/trace refit. Evaluated template renormalized by signed sum separately perrow.
fit_contract.window_aggregation: Original measure_spatial.py window_metrics copied unchanged except explicit estimator argument forwarding. Preserve L1, positive/negative/signed sums, centroids, zero-denominator flags and on/off per-pixel mean absolute residuals.

comparison: All18 outcomes compare the same numeric aggregate metrics to the original pooled two-sided estimator for the identical window. Each estimator retains all8 coordinate-selected control outcomes and target/control context for every numeric residual/amplitude metric. Raw/model/residual, true-offset maps, fit/background masks and original row/stitched/chip maps are saved separately by estimator and window.
limitations: Posthoc estimator sensitivity using the same observed pixels and same fixed controls; no independent observation.
Three-pixel background medians and MAD proxies are not calibrated noise models.
Positive-side background is geometrically closer to FP fiberB49, but outcomes do not identify FP contamination or any physical origin.
Eight local controls are dependent and not a significance distribution.
No model selection or preferred-background choice from these outcomes; both estimators and all failures are reported.
The original U label and all prior numerical outputs remain unchanged.
